description: This file defines the 'LeaveRequestComment' entity class used for representing comments associated with leave requests in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes properties for comment content, creation time, creator details, and references to related leave requests and users.

classes.name: LeaveRequestComment
classes.description: Entity class representing a comment on a leave request, with properties for ID, leave request reference, timestamp, creator info, and comment text.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the leave comment.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the leave comment.

methods.name: setLeaveRequest
methods.description: Associates this comment with a specific LeaveRequest.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Returns the creation timestamp of the comment.

methods.name: setCreatedAt
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp for the comment.

methods.name: getCreatedBy
methods.description: Returns the User who created the comment.

methods.name: setCreatedBy
methods.description: Sets the User as the creator of the comment.

methods.name: getCreatedByEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee who created the comment.

methods.name: setCreatedByEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee as the creator of the comment.
